intro: A compact and versatile pin-up board designed to keep notes, reminders, and inspiration organized and visible in any workspace.

features.title: Optimal Size for Any Workspace
features.text: At 600×600 mm, it provides ample space for notes, reminders, and inspiration without overwhelming your desk or wall.

features.title: Versatile Pin-Up Surface
features.text: Designed for easy pinning and repositioning, it’s perfect for documents, memos, photos, or creative boards.

features.title: Sleek, Compact Design
features.text: Its clean, balanced proportions make it ideal for small to medium offices, home studies, or collaborative zones.

features.title: Durable Construction
features.text: Built to last with a sturdy frame and resilient board material, keeping your notices secure over time.

features.title: Organized and Efficient
features.text: Helps maintain a clutter-free workspace by keeping all your important information visible, accessible, and well-arranged

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Note 600 X 600 Pin Up Board
